about: A child's first name, the nickname that child-put saves (board B-28). One limit on both sides: 1 to 24 UTF-16 code units, as the server's pattern counts them (no u flag; Dart String.length counts the same way), never graphemes. supabase/functions/child_name_vectors_test.ts asserts child-put/handler.ts (NICKNAME and the shape's max) equal server_pattern and max_utf16_units, and that the server takes every accept vector and refuses every reject vector that is not appOnly. app/test/child_name_test.dart asserts app/lib/data/child_name.dart gives each vector its reason, and the fake server of the sync tests refuses what server_pattern refuses. appOnly: the app refuses it (C1 controls and the invisible direction marks), the server today takes it. clientOnly: only the app can see the problem (it trims first; the server stores what it is sent). units: the length in UTF-16 code units, checked by both tests so that an editor cannot change a vector silently.

accept.name: Hebrew first and family-style name with a space
Hebrew with nikud (each mark is a unit)
12 Hebrew letters with nikud: 12 graphemes, 24 units
an emoji (a surrogate pair) at units 23 and 24

reject.name: 13 Hebrew letters with nikud: only 13 graphemes, but 26 units
an emoji (a surrogate pair) at units 24 and 25
a C1 control (U+0085) inside the name
